- Center_X:
  ```x```.
- Center_Y:
  ```y```.
```pygame.Rect(x,y,w,height(w)/2.0+width(h)/2.0+width(w)+width(h)+((height)+width(h))/2.0,y+(height(w)/2.0)+((width(w)+height(h))/2.0))
```
The logic here must carefully align:
- x & y - Center Points according to birds symmetry 
- Height, Width ratios from imagery’s definition parameters.

def select_rectangle_plate():
    for i in lunch_boxes.items():
        try:
            item in lunch[bywords[i]]
            del lunch[bywords[i]]
        except KeyError:
            pass
        except TypeError:
            pass

    selection_bento_food = list(lunch.keys())[-1] # take last item 
    print("lunchbox is "+selection_bento_food)
    return lunch[selection_bento_food]
